title: Eagles vs. Bears: Listen Live to Monday Night Football on SiriusXM
summary: Catch every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
Listen live as the[Philadelphia Eagles](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/philadelphia-eagles) and[Chicago Bears](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/Chicago-Bears) face off on[Monday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/monday-night-football-schedule-listen) during Week 3 of the 2026 NFL regular season live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.


[Eagles vs. Bears Today • 8:15PM ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk3-EaglesBears)


The Eagles visit the Bears on Monday, September 28 at 8:15pm ET from Soldier Field in Chicago.


### **How to Listen to Eagles vs. Bears**


**Date:** Monday, September 28
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** Soldier Field, Chicago, Illinois
**Eagles broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 825 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk3-EaglesBears) )
**Bears broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 805 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk3-EaglesBears) )
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio) (car and[app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk3-EaglesBears) )
**Spanish-language broadcast:** Ch. 194 (car), Ch. 832 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk3-EaglesBears) )


### **Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM**


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup.


Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios.


Visit[SiriusXM’s NFL schedule](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/nfl) to see upcoming games and find the latest channel information.
